children.title: Cycle 164 · Investigating Path-Dependent Divergence in Autonomous Value Systems

detail.title: Investigating Path-Dependent Divergence in Autonomous Value Systems
detail.summary: Building on previous inconclusive results from exp-divergent-values-test-89, this cycle focuses on revising the path-dependence hypothesis to better reflect the low internal divergence observed. We interpret the previous failure, propose a revised hypothesis for trajectory sensitivity, and initiate a new experiment to test if increasing initial perturbation magnitude yields detectable divergence.
